# Jan Kristensen

Jan Kristensen is mentioned once in the corpus as Cheflæge (Chief Physician) at the Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling (Department of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry) within Psykiatrien i Region Sjælland, and as the appointed representative of [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] on the steering committee (styregruppen) of the ADHD database [^src1]. This database is a Danish health quality registry that monitors the assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and adolescents under 18, and its steering group draws members from across Denmark, including chief physicians, specialist doctors, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists, and relative/patient representatives [^src1]. No further biographical, professional, or timeline details about Jan Kristensen are available in the source material.
